findings.summary: loadEligibilityContext reads the whole board, including the inflight manifests, on every computeBlockers call. This is cheap because the main-state graph is built lazily and only when an `after` entry is checked. If the dispatch tick ever gets hot, hoisting the context to the caller would avoid the repeated reads.
